findings.address_as_written: Palace of Fine Arts - reconstruction of Colonnades and Rotunda
findings.description: With the Stephenson Construction Company the low bidder at $38,600 to rebuild the structural portion of the Palace of Fine Arts' colonnades and rotunda, the Board of Park Commissioners asked the Board of Public Works to let and supervise the contract, none of it to be paid from park funds.

findings.description: The Board of Park Commissioners accepted a $5,000 bequest from the estate of Morris Herzstein, its income to keep up the Pershing statue in Golden Gate Park and the ground it stands on, and spent $250 of it refinishing the statue.
